title: Member registered
description: A librarian registered a new member, who can now borrow tools.

title: Tool added
description: A librarian added a tool to the catalog, in good condition and ready to lend.

title: Damage reported
description: A tool was marked as needing repair, by a librarian or when it was returned needing repair. It takes the tool out of lending and leaves any loan on it open.

title: Tool repaired
description: A librarian marked a damaged tool repaired, so it is in good condition and can be lent again.

title: Loan opened
description: A member borrowed a tool, and the loan runs until its due date.

title: Tool returned
description: A librarian recorded a tool's return, which closes its loan and says what condition the tool came back in.

title: Loan renewed
description: A member renewed a loan before it was overdue, which moved its due date on 14 calendar days.

title: Member reminded
description: The library reminded a member that their loan is due the next day (or that day, when the reminder could not go out the day before).
